spot.html_text: More formally, let ⟦M⟧ denote the Gödel number of arithmetical formula ⟦M⟧ , which is the result of assigning a numerical code to ⟦M⟧ . Let ⟦M⟧ be the formalized provability predicate for Peano Arithmetic, which is of the form ⟦M⟧ . Here, ⟦M⟧ is the formalized proof predicate of Peano Arithmetic, and ⟦M⟧ stands for “Gödel number ⟦M⟧ codes a correct proof from the axioms of Peano Arithmetic of the formula with Gödel number ⟦M⟧ ”. (For a more precise formulation, see Smoryński (1985), Davis (1958)
